items.informal_name: Odd Symmetry of Pre-Division Polynomials for Weierstrass Curves
items.type: ∀ {R : Type r} [inst : CommRing R] (W : WeierstrassCurve R) (n : ℤ), W.preΨ (-n) = -W.preΨ n
items.informal_description: For any integer $ n $, the pre-division polynomial $ \Psi_{-n} $ satisfies $ \Psi_{-n} = -\Psi_n $, where $ \Psi_n $ denotes the polynomial sequence defined for Weierstrass curves with odd symmetry extension for negative indices.

items.informal_description: For any integer $ n $, the division polynomial $ \Psi_{-n}(W) $ of a Weierstrass curve $ W $ over a ring $ R $ satisfies $ \Psi_{-n}(W) = -\Psi_n(W) $.

items.informal_name: Invariance of Sign Variations Under Polynomial Negation
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Ring R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] [IsOrderedRing R] (P : Polynomial R),
  (-P).signVariations = P.signVariations
items.informal_description: For any polynomial $ P $, the number of sign variations in $ -P $ is equal to the number of sign variations in $ P $, i.e., $ \operatorname{signVariations}(-P) = \operatorname{signVariations}(P) $.

items.type: ∀ (R : Type u_1) [inst : CommRing R] (n : ℤ), Polynomial.Chebyshev.S R (-n - 2) = -Polynomial.Chebyshev.S R n
items.informal_description: For any commutative ring $ R $ and integer $ n $, the Chebyshev polynomial $ S_{-n - 2}(X) $ is equal to the negative of $ S_n(X) $, i.e., $ S_{-n - 2}(X) = -S_n(X) $.
